help.stdout:
Usage: raft-computer [options] [command]

Raft Computer — connect this machine to Raft so agents can run here.

Options:
  -V, --version                   output the version number
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                 Log in to Raft on this machine.
  logout                          Log out of Raft on this machine. Connected
                                  servers are kept.
  attach [options] <serverSlug>   Connect this machine to one Raft server.
  setup [options] <serverSlug>    Set up Raft Computer for one server: log in
                                  if needed, connect this machine, then start.
  start [options] [serverSlug]    Start Raft Computer in the background.
  stop                            Stop Raft Computer and any agents it is
                                  running.
  restart [options] [serverSlug]  Restart Raft Computer.
  status                          Show whether Raft Computer is logged in,
                                  running, and connected to servers.
  doctor [options] [serverSlug]   Check Raft Computer setup and connection
                                  health. Secrets are never printed.
  logs [options] [serverSlug]     Show recent Raft Computer logs. Secrets are
                                  redacted.
  runners                         Advanced tools for agents running on this
                                  Computer.
  channel                         Show or set the Computer release channel.
                                  `latest` installs production releases;
                                  `alpha` follows staging builds;
                                  `pinned:<semver>` stays on one version.
  operation                       Inspect or acknowledge durable Computer
                                  upgrade receipts.
  upgrade [options]               Update Raft Computer to the latest version
                                  for this machine. By default it follows the
                                  saved release channel; pass --target-version
                                  to install a specific version.
  help [command]                  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer login [options]

Log in to Raft on this machine.

Options:
  --server-url <url>  Raft API base URL; defaults to
                      SLOCK_SERVER_URL/RAFT_SERVER_URL or
                      https://api.raft.build
  -h, --help          display help for command

Usage: raft-computer logout [options]

Log out of Raft on this machine. Connected servers are kept.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer attach [options] <serverSlug>

Connect this machine to one Raft server.

Arguments:
  serverSlug          target Raft server slug (canonical form `/myserver`; bare
                      `myserver` accepted)

Options:
  --server-url <url>  Raft API base URL; defaults to the saved user session,
                      SLOCK_SERVER_URL/RAFT_SERVER_URL or
                      https://api.raft.build
  --name <name>       Computer display name; defaults to a sanitized hostname
  --no-start          connect without starting Raft Computer
  --foreground        run the service in this terminal instead of the
                      background
  -h, --help          display help for command

Usage: raft-computer setup [options] <serverSlug>

Set up Raft Computer for one server: log in if needed, connect this machine,
then start.

Arguments:
  serverSlug             target Raft server slug (canonical form `/myserver`;
                         bare `myserver` accepted)

Options:
  --server-url <url>     Raft API base URL; defaults to the saved user session,
                         SLOCK_SERVER_URL/RAFT_SERVER_URL or
                         https://api.raft.build
  --name <name>          Computer display name for a new attachment; defaults
                         to a sanitized hostname
  --machine <machineId>  adopt the Computer/daemon row with this id (shown on
                         the web Computers page) instead of matching local
                         evidence
  --fresh                create a new connection after unmatched local legacy
                         evidence is printed
  --verbose              show detailed migration evidence during setup
  --no-start             finish setup without starting Raft Computer
  --foreground           run the service in this terminal instead of the
                         background
  -y, --yes              allow non-interactive setup after confirming the
                         planned actions
  -h, --help             display help for command

Usage: raft-computer start [options] [serverSlug]

Start Raft Computer in the background.

Arguments:
  serverSlug    optional: scope to one attached server (canonical `/myserver`;
                bare accepted; default: all attached)

Options:
  --foreground  run the service in this terminal instead of the background
  -h, --help    display help for command

Usage: raft-computer stop [options]

Stop Raft Computer and any agents it is running.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer restart [options] [serverSlug]

Restart Raft Computer.

Arguments:
  serverSlug    optional: scope to one attached server (canonical `/myserver`;
                bare accepted; default: all attached)

Options:
  --foreground  run the service in this terminal instead of the background
  -h, --help    display help for command

Usage: raft-computer status [options]

Show whether Raft Computer is logged in, running, and connected to servers.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer doctor [options] [serverSlug]

Check Raft Computer setup and connection health. Secrets are never printed.

Arguments:
  serverSlug           optional: scope to one attached server (canonical
                       `/myserver`; bare accepted; default: all attached)
                       (scopes recent-crash detail to that server)

Options:
  --fix                after diagnosis, clean up stale local state when it is
                       safe
  --migration-details  show local legacy migration evidence and server-relative
                       exclusion reasons
  -h, --help           display help for command

Usage: raft-computer logs [options] [serverSlug]

Show recent Raft Computer logs. Secrets are redacted.

Arguments:
  serverSlug   optional: scope to one attached server (canonical `/myserver`;
               bare accepted; default: all attached) (required when ≥2
               attached; ignored with --service)

Options:
  --lines <n>  trailing lines to show (default 200)
  --service    show machine-level logs instead of server-specific logs
  -h, --help   display help for command

Usage: raft-computer runners [options] [command]

Advanced tools for agents running on this Computer.

Options:
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  list [options] [serverSlug]  List agents running on this Computer.
  stop <agentId> [serverSlug]  Stop an agent running on this Computer.
  help [command]               display help for command

Usage: raft-computer channel [options] [command]

Show or set the Computer release channel. `latest` installs production
releases; `alpha` follows staging builds; `pinned:<semver>` stays on one
version.

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  show                          Show the saved Computer release channel. If
                                none is set, this prints `latest`.
  set <channel>                 Set which release channel future `raft-computer
                                upgrade` commands should use.
  versions [options] [channel]  List installable Computer versions published on
                                a release channel.
  help [command]                display help for command

Usage: raft-computer operation [options] [command]

Inspect or acknowledge durable Computer upgrade receipts.

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  acknowledge <operationId>  Acknowledge one exact terminal K receipt without
                             deleting its audit record.
  help [command]             display help for command

Usage: raft-computer upgrade [options]

Update Raft Computer to the latest version for this machine. By default it
follows the saved release channel; pass --target-version to install a specific
version.

Options:
  --dry-run                  resolve the update package only; server
                             authorization is not checked and no changes are
                             made
  --channel <name>           use a release channel for this invocation only.
                             `latest` installs production releases; `alpha`
                             follows staging builds; `pinned:<semver>` stays on
                             one version.
  --target-version <semver>  install a specific version
  --rollback                 restore the previous version from the last
                             successful upgrade; mutually exclusive with
                             --target-version/--channel/--dry-run
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Usage: raft-computer runners list [options] [serverSlug]

List agents running on this Computer.

Arguments:
  serverSlug  optional: scope to one attached server (canonical `/myserver`;
              bare accepted; default: all attached) (optional; default lists
              this Computer's runners across attached servers)

Options:
  --all       list all runners on the selected server (legacy server-wide view;
              serverSlug required when ≥2 attached)
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer runners stop [options] <agentId> [serverSlug]

Stop an agent running on this Computer.

Arguments:
  agentId     id of the agent to stop
  serverSlug  optional: scope to one attached server (canonical `/myserver`;
              bare accepted; default: all attached) (required when ≥2 attached)

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer channel show [options]

Show the saved Computer release channel. If none is set, this prints `latest`.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer channel set [options] <channel>

Set which release channel future `raft-computer upgrade` commands should use.

Arguments:
  channel     `latest` installs production releases; `alpha` follows staging
              builds; `pinned:<semver>` stays on one version

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Usage: raft-computer channel versions [options] [channel]

List installable Computer versions published on a release channel.

Arguments:
  channel          release channel to list; defaults to the saved channel

Options:
  --json           print the stable machine-readable response
  --limit <count>  maximum versions to return (1-100)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Usage: raft-computer operation acknowledge [options] <operationId>

Acknowledge one exact terminal K receipt without deleting its audit record.

Arguments:
  operationId  exact K operation id shown by `raft-computer status`

Options:
  -h, --help   display help for command
